commands.label: Feature 202 iteration 002 suites (T016 to T023), added 2026-10-17 with T017. Its own lane because lanes a and b would drop under the 2.4x headroom floor with it. message-identity (T017, FR-027, SC-010): one typed approval through the message hook and N turn ends records once on Claude, Codex and Copilot, a retype still records, the backup path records once, and a Copilot miss is reported, and co-review rounds 1 to 4 replay their sixteen findings, and B4F-137 (a typed approval replaces an unspent turn-end record). workshop-delegation (T020, FR-031): the wide forms cover every remaining lens, the narrow form names the phrase, the mixed lens closes as delegated (12 s). workshop-question-tool (T021, FR-032): no shipped host instruction or skill permits a question tool for workshop questions (2 s). approval-form (T018, FR-029): on Claude nothing inside a paste counts and a phrase on its own line outside every paste does, within the observed paste-size boundary; a quoted menu is refused on every host; other hosts keep the phrase alone and say why; a reset typed for a waiting round authorizes it. host-binding-match (T016, FR-028): every recorded payload against every validated host's deployed hook - another host's payload stands down and writes nothing, an unknown shape is handled and logged once, a duplicate receipt ID is refused (71 s). Measured alone 274 s against 660 s (2.41x), with T018 to T021 added; the timeout went 600 to 660 to keep the 2.4x floor. Split on 2026-10-21: host-binding-match grew to 114 s alone with the probe payloads (T026), so it moved to f202-i002-suites-b with the sub-agent suite (T028); this lane measured about 203 s alone against 660 s (3.2x).

arguments: $fail = 0; $results = @('tests/integration/workshop-agenda-confirmation.tests.ps1','tests/integration/cycle-reset-mirror.tests.ps1','tests/integration/workshop-typed-turn-authority.tests.ps1','tests/integration/workshop-material-packet-language.tests.ps1','tests/integration/session-orientation-rendered.tests.ps1','tests/unit/workshop-refusal-contract.tests.ps1','tests/unit/review-approve-round-host-resolution.tests.ps1','tests/unit/review-flag-whitelist-parity.tests.ps1','tests/unit/pause-choice-carries-round-approval.tests.ps1','tests/unit/banner-ids-are-glossed.tests.ps1','tests/unit/session-orientation-obligation.tests.ps1','tests/unit/module-packaging-identity.tests.ps1','tests/unit/maintainer-skill-host-parity.tests.ps1','tests/unit/task-progress-no-demotion.tests.ps1','tests/unit/reviewer-closeout-artifacts-generate.tests.ps1','tests/unit/scaffold-migration-and-pending.tests.ps1','tests/unit/no-automatic-variable-collisions.tests.ps1','tests/unit/deployed-extension-integrity.tests.ps1','tests/unit/scaffold-writes-once.tests.ps1','tests/integration/deployed-extension-marker-on-update.tests.ps1','tests/integration/review-record-survives-its-own-commit.tests.ps1','tests/integration/no-code-without-approval.tests.ps1','tests/integration/closed-iterations-are-history.tests.ps1','tests/unit/round-approval-typed-authority.tests.ps1','tests/unit/coverage-is-a-decision.tests.ps1') | ForEach-Object -Parallel { $s = $_; & pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File $s *> $null; [pscustomobject]@{ Suite = $s; ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE } } -ThrottleLimit 6; foreach ($r in @($results)) { if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { $fail = 1; Write-Host "workshop-suite FAILED: $($r.Suite)" } }; if (@($results).Count -ne 25) { $fail = 1; Write-Host "workshop-suite FAILED: parallel run returned $(@($results).Count) results, expected 25" }; exit $fail
commands.label: SLICE lane: the suites this slice touches, plus the workshop-authority suites added 2026-08-17. The beta3 workshop fixes (W10-W18) shipped with no lane covering them, so a walk regression could only be caught by someone remembering to run them by hand - the same 'a guard only guards code whose author runs it' shape the class-guard lane exists to prevent. The full deterministic registry is the RELEASE GATE lane and runs at the certification round, not on every slice (maintainer ruling 2026-08-10). The W29-W32 review-frame suite joined 2026-08-20: those four defects let a review be recorded as clean and independent while its frame held one planning document, so the guard belongs where a slice touching review machinery runs it. W33's declared-coverage suite joined it 2026-08-20: it is the only guard standing between a review that read nothing and a recorded clean pass, and it spans the candidate contract, the ingest degrade and the store's allowed-field list. W34's authorship and derived-independence suites joined 2026-08-20; they span the hook that observes the write, the store derivation, and the validator that recomputes it. The packaging-identity suite joined 2026-08-21: it pins the two mechanisms that turned out not to exist - a supported local install, and a build stamp derived from what is actually in the package. PARALLELIZED 2026-08-24 (DRIFT-199-I001-116): the lane grew past its own budget - 24 sequential child pwsh spawns measured 370s cold in a faithful frozen-tree materialization against a 480s bound, and two review launches died on exactly that timeout. The suites are isolated processes on GUID-scoped temp fixtures, so they now run 6 at a time; the result count is pinned so a swallowed suite cannot read as a pass. Measured cold+env-scrubbed after: 199s, giving the 480s bound 2.4x headroom, inside the project's own measured-headroom convention. Cycle-reset guard added 2026-08-30: the truth gate replayed the GLOBAL last-authorized boundary into a NEW iteration, forward-writing its plan scaffold from planning to complete and wedging every next-iteration cycle. No existing mirror fixture crossed a cycle boundary, so nothing saw it. RESTORED AND SPLIT 2026-10-15 (202 T015, DRIFT-029): re-timed cold with only these env_refs, the single lane passed in 298.8 s against 480 s (1.61x, under the 2.4x floor). -a holds the 25 parallel script suites, measured 181.1 s (2.65x); -b holds the Pester block, measured 112.9 s (4.25x).
